unit: fire cell-days, sum of estimated over the season months

rules.variant: fire_only unless predictor selection inside the cross-validation beats it in both mean RPSS and mean MAE skill over the three macroregions and all leads.
rules.skill: A unit and lead uses the model only if backtest RPSS >= 0.05 and MAE skill > 0.0; otherwise climatology.
rules.activity: Departments with median August-October activity below 100 fire cell-days in 2003-2025 get no forecast.

backtest.scheme: leave-one-year-out; predictor set, ridge alpha and spread chosen inside each training fold

sources.precipitation: NASA POWER monthly PRECTOTCORR, mean over grid points of each macroregion; departments use their macroregion.

notes: Probabilities come from a normal distribution in log space centred on the forecast, with the spread of leave-one-year-out residuals of the training years.
ENSO indices enter with the 3-month window ending one month before the origin; precipitation windows end one month before the origin.
Department series sum the estimated cell-days of map.parquet; before 2012 part of each month is spread over cells with the VIIRS 2013-2024 climatology.
Department forecasts are published only where the backtest beats climatology; selecting units by backtest skill favours some lucky units.
